description: Gestión de Residuos en Puntos Verdes is a dataset listed in City of Buenos Aires open data portal (BA Data), an open data portal, published or maintained by Agencia de Protección Ambiental. Información y ubicación geográfica sobre los centros de recepción de materiales reciclables. Coverage: Ciudad de Buenos Aires. The portal files it under the publisher Agencia de Protección Ambiental. Its tags are RSU, ambiente, basura, cambio climático, mapa. It offers 18 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, XLSX, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-2.5-AR. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-caba-portal.
